# Paired-construction exposure response checkpoints — v1

2026-11-14. Prospective owner completion of response-trigger sampling in3418a134, before any retained or constructed study result. Same fixed-producer source task, no economic outcome tuning, grace inferred from data or new run authority.

The gross1.25 / absolute-net.25 / name.75 thresholds are modeled portfolio RESPONSE triggers, not guaranteed continuous exposure invariants. Assess them (a) at every eligible ordinary book mark checkpoint before beginning new construction, and (b) when the one predeclared paired construction at the current eligible execution event reaches its completion/termination checkpoint. Record exposures after EVERY actual fill, including intermediate short-only net~-.5; those real transients remain reported extrema and risks, not erased or called simultaneous execution. Merely passing through a short-first intermediate net magnitude~.5 does NOT by itself latch a flatten that bars the already declared paired long.

A construction ends when both permitted incremental sides finish; OR any side is blocked/refused/cancelled/expires, outstanding orders cannot complete under the current host RoutingBoundary, a new mark/event must be processed, or the host boundary reaches its end. No retry/deadline extension or waiting across another execution/mark event to hide one-sided risk. Expired/cancelled partial/native actual quantities remain truth; freeze final actual checkpoint before other discretionary instructions. At that checkpoint, any selected exposure threshold breach queues next-eligible-CLOSE fullflatten and blocks further risk per existing rules. If construction ends without a breach, normal later-genuine-formation rule remains; no second discretionary construction at this event. This does not silently create a market fill at boundary-end or change native timestamp eligibility.

ALL cash/funding/locate/initial equity/restriction and current maintenance/buffer admission checks still apply before EVERY risk-increasing order. Actual current mark/default, reconciled execution funding/margin failures and other mandatory-risk triggers remain immediate/sticky at their selected checkpoints, including during paired construction. DEFAULT_EVER blocks the paired long/new risk; an actual funding/restriction/maintenance failure may prevent its completion. This exception is ONLY for the three exposure RESPONSE trigger samplings, not credit, default, an unlimited oversize fill, fee waiver or locate cap bypass. Proposed quantities remain frozen at D and actual short fill caps subsequent long notional as selected.

If a valid intervening mark/gap/partial fill makes a counterpart impossible, close construction and expose pending one-sided risk at the declared checkpoint; never synthesize the missing side. Report transient per-fill exposure separately from response-checkpoint exposures, with construction IDs/start/end/reason/order/fill identities. No claim of beta neutrality, guaranteed continuous net cap, simultaneous pair execution or executable intraday hedge. In tail/default/blackout cases these limitations remain explicit. Independent QA should test initial short-first net~.5 not prematurely flattening, failed/partial counterpart ending construction and triggering response if needed, boundary/newmark termination, and default/funding checks never postponed.

This controlling clarification narrows earlier unqualified realized-cap wording to the explicit sampling above before dependent values. No repeated old feasibility, retained/native study call, candidate reservation or48account allocation. Existing source author/reviewer lineage consumes it; fee/quote/input work continues independently.
